items.name: rea
items.title: REA · Reverse Engineer Anything
items.description: Reverse engineering MCP: native binaries, Electron/web apps, .NET, EVM bytecode, Android packages, firmware and Apple apps, with Ghidra, IDA or Hopper providers.

items.name: playwright
items.title: Playwright
items.description: Official Microsoft browser automation: navigate, click, type, screenshot, read the accessibility tree and run page scripts.

items.name: chrome-devtools
items.title: Chrome DevTools
items.description: Drive a real Chrome: console, network, performance traces, screenshots and DOM inspection.

items.name: desktop-commander
items.title: Desktop Commander
items.description: Terminal and file editing on the host: run commands, read and write files, search and manage long-running processes.

items.name: context7
items.title: Context7
items.description: Up-to-date library documentation and code examples pulled on demand, so the model stops guessing APIs.

items.name: filesystem
items.title: Filesystem
items.description: Official reference server for reading and writing files. The command grants the current folder; edit it to grant another path.

items.name: memory
items.title: Memory
items.description: Official knowledge-graph memory that persists entities and relations between sessions.

items.name: everything
items.title: Everything
items.description: Official reference server that exercises every MCP feature: tools, resources, prompts and sampling.

items.name: notion
items.title: Notion
items.description: Official Notion server: search, read and update pages and databases. Needs NOTION_TOKEN in the server environment.

items.name: sequential-thinking
items.title: Sequential Thinking
items.description: Official structured-reasoning server: break a hard problem into reviseable thought steps.

items.name: supabase
items.title: Supabase
items.description: Official Supabase server: query tables, manage projects and run SQL. Append --access-token=<token> to the command.

items.name: sentry
items.title: Sentry
items.description: Official Sentry server: search issues and events and inspect stack traces. Append --access-token=<token>.

items.name: slack
items.title: Slack
items.description: Official Slack server: list channels, read history and post messages. Needs SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and SLACK_TEAM_ID.

items.name: postgres
items.title: Postgres
items.description: Official read-only Postgres server. Append your postgresql:// connection string to the command.

items.name: figma
items.title: Figma
items.description: Developer MCP for Figma layouts and styles, in stdio mode. Needs FIGMA_API_KEY.

items.name: firecrawl
items.title: Firecrawl
items.description: Crawl, scrape and extract structured data from websites. Needs FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.

items.name: mongodb
items.title: MongoDB
items.description: Official MongoDB server: inspect collections, run queries and manage indexes. Defaults to localhost; add --connectionString for Atlas.

items.name: github
items.title: GitHub
items.description: Official reference GitHub server: repos, issues, pull requests and code search. Needs GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.

items.name: apify
items.title: Apify Actors
items.description: Run any Apify actor as an MCP tool: scraping, maps, social and market data. Needs APIFY_TOKEN.

items.name: exa
items.title: Exa Search
items.description: Neural web search and page contents for agents. Needs EXA_API_KEY.

items.name: puppeteer
items.title: Puppeteer
items.description: Reference browser automation server: navigate, screenshot and evaluate in a headless browser.

items.name: brave-search
items.title: Brave Search
items.description: Web, local and image search through the Brave API. Needs BRAVE_API_KEY.

items.name: kubernetes
items.title: Kubernetes
items.description: Manage a cluster: pods, logs, deployments and Helm, using your kubeconfig.

items.name: stripe
items.title: Stripe
items.description: Official Stripe server: customers, payments, invoices and refunds. Append --api-key=<key> to the command.

items.name: tavily
items.title: Tavily
items.description: Search, extract and crawl tuned for agents. Needs TAVILY_API_KEY.
